The '''Graverobber's Delight''' was the name given to part of the [[Starship Graveyard (Hoth)|Starship Graveyard]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Graverobber's Delight appears as part of the Starship Graveyard on Hoth in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="TOR" />
